exposure: Gestational age at birth (23, 24, and 25 weeks)
cohort: All Australian births and all NICU admissions during 2010-2013 at 23, 24, and 25 weeks' gestation
finding: This study found that at 23 weeks' gestation, birth weight and sex were significant factors influencing NICU admission in the Australian population, while these factors had less impact at 24 and 25 weeks.
